priorInvariants.title: Core Playtest V0.1 Is The Primary Mechanical Source For M5 Except Where Explicit Approved Designer Or Canon Clarification Supersedes It
Unresolved Source Ambiguity Is Preserved Rather Than Silently Reconciled
Prowess-Specific Mechanics Do Not Enter The Generic @prowess/rules Package
Prowess Domain Semantics Live In A Dedicated Pure Domain Layer
Every Canonical Structured Prowess Definition Carries Exact EntityVersion Identity
Definition Payload Schema Version Is Explicit And Independent Of EntityVersion
Ruleset Provenance Is Preserved Through Exact Prowess Definition Materialization
Definition Bundles Contain Only Versions Pinned By Their Exact RulesetContext
Definitions From Different Exact Rulesets Are Never Silently Mixed
Compilation Uses Exact Definition Versions And Never Latest/Current Lookup
Prowess Compilation Emits M4 EvaluationPlans Rather Than Reimplementing The M4 Rules Engine
Compilation Performs No Hidden Gameplay Calculation
Compiled Step Identity And Ordering Are Deterministic
Compilation Preserves A Domain-To-Evaluation-Step Source Map
Definition And Composition Are Separate Layers
Composition And Runtime State Are Separate Layers
Presentation Does Not Own Or Duplicate Prowess Mechanics
Source Prose Is Never Parsed As Runtime Rule Logic
Import Review Does Not Automatically Create Canonical Executable Prowess Rules
Canon Governance Is Explicit And Is Never Inferred By A Compiler
Spell Composition Supports Multiple Compatible Spell Effect Branches
Targeting Defines Delivery Geometry And Legal Placement; It Does Not Determine The Applied Effect Or Resolution
Mana Efficiency Payment Never Rewrites Listed Cost
Mana Lock Represents Reserved Capacity Rather Than Resource Spending
Spell And Maneuver Construction Share The Prowess Modular Ability Construction Framework While Retaining Branch-Specific Rules And Catalogs
Summoning Grants No Unauthored Capability
Historical Prowess Definitions Never Resolve Through Latest Or Current Selection
Prowess Domain Inputs And Outputs Are Immutable Detached Plain Data
Prowess Compilation Is Deterministic
Changes To The Frozen M4 Foundation Require Explicit Approval
Spell And Maneuver Targeting Use Common Targeting Semantics Where Applicable Without Requiring Shared Canonical Targeting Definitions
Equivalent AoE Geometry Has The Same Spatial Meaning Across Spell And Maneuver Construction; Attached Effects Determine The Outcome
Spell Effects And Maneuver Effects Implement A Common Effect Contract But Remain Separate Definition Families
Spell Traits And Maneuver Traits Implement A Common Trait Contract But Remain Separate Definition Families
Duration, Conditions, Affinity And Resolution Are Shared Ability-Construction Concepts Whose Legal Content And Consequences May Be Branch-Specific
AbilityKind Determines Legal Definition Catalogs And Branch-Specific Rules; It Does Not Replace The Shared Construction Framework
Evocation Is The Canonical Affinity Name; Emission Is Preserved Only As Historical / Legacy Source Terminology
A Shared Component Contract Never Makes Cross-Branch Definitions Automatically Interchangeable
An Affinity-Assisted Maneuver Remains A Maneuver Unless An Explicit Rule Changes Its AbilityKind
Ability Conditions And Target Conditions Are Distinct Concepts: Construction Restrictions Do Not Automatically Become Status Effects
Character Die Is The Canonical Identity For Player Dice And Player Die Legacy Terminology
Standard Character Die Progression Is Exact By Level And Is Structured Data, Not Scattered Hard-Coded Branches
Dice Evaluation Consumes Explicit Runtime Roll Results And Introduces No Randomness Into The Deterministic Rules Layer
Half Character Die Uses Half The Die's Maximum Face As A Static Value
Prowess Uses Exactly Six Canonical Core Ability Scores: STR, AGI, CON, PER, RES, PRO
Standard Ability Scores Are Bounded From 1 Through 10 Unless An Exact Rule Explicitly Overrides The Bound
Rank Ordering And Rank Numeric Effects Are Separate Concepts
Base Skill Rank Bonuses Are Untrained 0, Trained +2, Expert +4, Master +6
Skill Checks Use The Stat Chosen For The Character's Approach Rather Than A Stat Permanently Owned By The Skill
Core Roll Arithmetic Is Executed By M4 Formula And Threshold Resolution By M4 Requirement Rather Than By Hidden Compiler Math
Advantage Selects The Higher Of Two Natural Character Die Results And Adds Modifiers Once
Disadvantage Selects The Lower Of Two Natural Character Die Results And Adds Modifiers Once
Selected Natural Die Result Is Preserved Separately From Final Roll Total
Attack Rolls Use Character Die + PER + Prowess Accuracy + Explicit Bonuses Unless An Exact Rule Specifies Otherwise
Prowess Accuracy Bonus Is floor(PRO / 3) And Remains An Explicit To-Hit Contribution
Dodge Is The Canonical Defense Term; Evasion Is Legacy Terminology For The Same Defense
Base Dodge Is Half Character Die + AGI + floor(PER / 3) Before Other Explicit Modifiers
A Maximum Natural Character Die Result Creates A Critical Threat But Does Not Automatically Hit
Critical Hit Requires Both A Critical Threat And A Successful Attack
Saving Throws Use Character Die + Explicit Save Stat + Explicit Bonuses
Targeting Never Selects A Saving Throw; The Applicable Effect Or Rule Does
Character DC Is Half Character Die + PRO + floor(RES / 3) + Explicit Bonuses
Maximum HP Is Base HP From Race Plus CON Before Other Explicit Bonuses
Maximum MP Is Base MP From Race Plus RES Before Other Explicit Bonuses
Base HP And Base MP Are Racial Starting Values Rather Than Multipliers
Strength Grants floor(STR / 3) Natural Armor Before Other Armor Sources
Agility Grants floor(AGI / 3) Additional AP Capacity Above The Base 3 AP
Base Range Is 15 Feet Times PER
Base Mana Efficiency Equals PRO And Remains A Payment Resource Rather Than A Listed-Cost Modifier
Base Signature Ability Capacity Equals PRO
Skill Automatic Success Uses Ability Score + Skill Rank Bonus Against DC Without Requiring A Character Die Roll
Stat Mastery At Level 10 And Stat 10 Produces Advantage On Applicable Rolls Rather Than A Numeric Modifier
Unresolved Movement Formula Conflict M5-SC-006 Must Not Produce Executable Canonical Movement Math
WO2 Derived Character Statistics Calculate Through M4 Primitives While Runtime Resource Mutation Remains Deferred To The Resource / Action-Economy Work
Base Movement Equals 5 Feet Times AGI Before Size Or Other Explicit Movement Modifiers
Size-Based Movement Adjustments Are Explicit Structured Rules And Are Never Inferred From Occupied Space
Advantage And Disadvantage Are Non-Stacking Presence Signals
If At Least One Advantage And At Least One Disadvantage Apply To The Same Roll, The Roll Resolves Normally Regardless Of Duplicate Counts
Roll-State Resolution Preserves Every Contributing Advantage And Disadvantage Source For Provenance And Explanation
HP, MP, ME, AP And Counter Action Are Distinct Runtime Resources
Resource Maximum Or Capacity Is Distinct From Current Resource Amount
HP Does Not Refresh Automatically On Turn Or Round Boundaries
MP Does Not Refresh Automatically On Turn Or Round Boundaries
AP Refreshes To Current AP Capacity At The Start Of The Creature's Turn
Unused AP Expires At End Of Turn Unless An Explicit Rule Preserves It
Default Counter Action Capacity Is One And Refreshes At The Start Of Each Round
Counter Actions Never Accumulate Across Rounds By Default
Counter Action And AP Are Separate Resources And Are Not Implicitly Interchangeable
Mana Efficiency Maximum Equals PRO And Current ME Refreshes To That Maximum At The Start Of Each Round
Mana Efficiency Is Used Before MP Only For Costs Explicitly Declared ME-Eligible
Mana Efficiency Payment Never Alters The Listed Cost Being Paid
Prowess Multi-Resource Payment Is Atomic On Insufficient Resources
Reserved MP Capacity Reduces Available Maximum Without Spending Current MP
Releasing Reserved MP Capacity Restores Capacity But Never Refills Current MP
Core Runtime Resource Transitions Compile Through M4 Resource Operations And Do Not Reimplement Resource Arithmetic
Prowess AP Is A Spendable Resource Rather Than A Fixed Number Of Action Slots
Core Action Costs Are Versioned Structured Definitions And May Be Overridden Only By Explicit Rules
Move Costs One AP And Provides Movement Allowance Rather Than Permanently Changing Movement
Movement Allowance May Be Split Around Other Actions Until The Purchased Allowance Is Exhausted
Difficult Terrain Consumes Movement Allowance At Double The Normal Rate Unless An Explicit Rule Overrides It
Combat Uses Side Initiative And The Player Side Does Not Default To Individual Character Initiative Slots
Initiative Uses Character Die + Half PER + Half AGI + Explicit Bonuses With No Implicit Rounding
Initiative Ties Resolve By Highest PER, Then Highest AGI, Then Explicit Reroll Requirement
Surprise Prevents Counter Action Use During The First Round Without Inventing A Fixed AP Penalty
Runtime Rules Evaluation Never Persists Current Combat Resource State As A Side Effect
Resource And Action-Economy Steps Preserve Exact Prowess Definition And Ruleset Provenance
Zero HP Is Exposed As Resource Depletion But Full Downed And Death-Save Resolution Remains A Separate Later Subsystem
Creature Occupied Space And Creature Movement Speed Are Separate Mechanical Concepts
Repeated Sprint Execution Must Never Exponentially Multiply Movement
Ordinary Action Costs Are Atomic And Do Not Become Multi-Turn Commitments Unless The Action Explicitly Supports Such A Rule
Movement Equals Base Movement Multiplied By AGI; Base Movement Is A Separate Authored Creature Value
Sprint Grants Four Times The Creature's Movement And Does Not Require A Separate Total Movement Statistic
Creature Size May Alter Base Movement Only Through An Explicit Structured Rule; Occupied Space Never Implies Base Movement
Prowess Has Exactly Six Canonical Affinity Identities: Evocation, Conjuration, Transmutation, Divination, Enhancement And Manipulation
Evocation Is Canonical And Emission Is Historical Legacy Terminology Only
Affinity Ownership And Affinity Rank Are Separate Concepts
A Level 1 Primary Affinity Is Owned At Rank NONE And Becomes Trained At Level 3 Under Standard Progression
At Level 6 Standard Affinity Advancement Is Either Primary Trained To Expert Or A Secondary Affinity At Trained
The Starting Rank Of A New Level 9 Affinity Remains Unresolved Until Explicit Canon Resolves M5-SC-035
Affinity Rank Order Is NONE, TRAINED, EXPERT, MASTER And Is Distinct From Other Rank Systems' Numeric Effects
Affinity Strength Discount Is 0%, 10%, 20%, 30% For NONE, TRAINED, EXPERT, MASTER Respectively
Multiple Strength Keyword Matches From One Governing Affinity Apply The Rank Discount Only Once
Affinity Strength And Weakness Matching Uses Exact Structured Keyword Identity And Never Fuzzy Text Matching
Every Affinity Weakness Owns An Exact Authored Percentage Penalty Rather Than Requiring Severity Inference
When Multiple Weaknesses Of The Same Governing Affinity Match, Only The Highest Applicable Penalty Is Applied Unless An Explicit Rule Says Otherwise
All Matched Weaknesses Remain Visible For Provenance Even When Only The Highest Penalty Is Applied
When An Ability Matches Both A Strength And A Weakness, Both Modifiers Apply
Affinity Strength Discount Applies Before Affinity Weakness Penalty
Affinity Modifier Arithmetic Does Not Round; Final Rounding Belongs To The Later Branch Cost Pipeline
An Affinity Weakness Normally Changes Cost Rather Than Prohibiting Ability Construction
Affinity-Relevant Keywords May Be Contributed By Explicit Targeting, Effects, Traits And Other Valid Ability Components
Affinity Does Not Infer Mechanical Keywords From Component Display Names Or Targeting Geometry
One Explicit Governing Affinity Is Required For WO4 Executable Affinity Cost Evaluation; No Affinity Is Auto-Selected
WO4 Does Not Stack Discounts From Multiple Owned Affinities Without An Explicit Future Multi-Affinity Rule
The Governing Affinity Must Be An Exact Affinity Owned By The Character Under The Same Exact Ruleset
Affinity Authority Requires At Least Trained Rank
Affinity Authority Effect Capacity Is One, Two, Three At Trained, Expert, Master
Affinity Authority Base Trait Capacity Is One, Two, Three At Trained, Expert, Master
Arcane And Affinity Authority Capacities Do Not Add Together Unless An Explicit Feature Says Otherwise
Affinity Authority Access And Affinity Cost Modification Are Separate Mechanical Concepts
Qualifying For A Trait Through Affinity Rank Never Removes That Trait's Cost Or Other Requirements
Spell Affinity Strengths And Weaknesses Modify Listed MP Rather Than Runtime Mana Payment
Affinity Never Directly Modifies Spell AP Unless An Explicit Rule Says So; Its Normal AP Effect Occurs Indirectly Through Later MP-Based AP Derivation
Spell Affinity MP Economics Are Never Automatically Applied To Maneuver AP Or Other Maneuver Costs
Affinity Alignment Semantics Are Shared Across Ability Construction While Branch-Specific Cost And Access Rules Remain Explicit
Affinity Definitions, Rank Rules And Keyword Contributions Preserve Exact Ruleset And EntityVersion Provenance
Historical Affinity Evaluation Never Resolves Through Latest Or Current Content
Affinity Compilation Uses Existing M4 Keyword, Requirement And Modifier Primitives Rather Than Reimplementing Them
Affinity Cost Compilation Performs No Hidden Percentage Arithmetic In The Prowess Compiler
Affinity Evaluation Is Deterministic, Immutable, JSON-Safe And Free Of Global Mutable Affinity State
A New Level 9 Affinity Starts At Trained And Every Affinity Ranks Independently
Base Movement Is Authored Per Creature Size And Is Never Derived From Occupied Space; Massive Remains Pending Canon
Arcane Rank Is The Arcana Skill's Rank; Arcana Rank Is Its Legacy Name
Base Movement Is Authored Per Creature Size: Small 5, Medium 5, Large 10, Huge 20, Massive 40 Feet; Never Derived From Occupied Space
Percentage Cost Modifiers Combine Into One Net Percentage Applied Once; Final Rounding Is Normal, Once, At The End Of Spell Creation
Spell Authority Is Explicit: Arcane Authority Reads The Arcana Skill Rank At Trained Or Higher; Affinity Authority Reads The Governing Affinity Owned At Trained Or Higher; Never Auto-Switched
Casting Condition Capacity Comes From Arcane Rank Only: Untrained 0, Trained 1, Expert 2, Master 3, Under Either Authority
Martial Trained Is The Maneuver Minimum; Martial Rank Is The Martial Skill Rank; Affinity Never Substitutes For Or Adds Maneuver Capacity
Targeting Determines Range, Area, Target Count, Delivery, Origin And Placement; It Never Determines An Effect's Mechanical Outcome
Targeting Never Selects An Attack Roll, Saving Throw Or Save Stat; Resolution Belongs To Effects Even When A Targeting Type Has A Typical Delivery Family

A Standard Ability Composition Has Exactly One Branch-Specific Targeting Definition, And A Standard Multi-Effect Spell Shares That Targeting Across All Effects Unless An Explicit Modifier Says Otherwise
SPELL_TARGETING And MANEUVER_TARGETING Remain Distinct Exact Definition Families Even When They Share The Same Semantic Geometry
Projectile Is A Canonical Spell Targeting Type Distinct From Single Target, While Its Base MP Cost Remains Deferred Until M5-SC-039 Is Resolved
Trigger-Based And Glyph/Anchor Are Targeting Add-Ons, Not Canonical Base Spell Targeting Types
Default Spell Range Equals 15 Feet Times PER Unless An Exact Targeting Or Ability Rule Overrides It
Spell Range And Spell Area Are Separate Mechanical Values And Must Never Be Collapsed Into One Distance
Spell Line Length Equals 15 Feet Times PRO; The Ambiguous Base Line Width Rule Must Remain Deferred Until M5-SC-040 Is Resolved
Spell Cone Length Equals 10 Feet Times PRO
Spell Radius, Zone Radius And Aura Radius Each Use Five Feet Times PRO Unless An Exact Rule Overrides Them
The Superseded Plus-Three-MP Radius/Zone/Aura Expansion Rule Is Never Used; Widen Area Is A Targeting Trait Costing Six MP And Is Owned By The Trait Subsystem
Targeting Compatibility Uses Exact Structured Identity Or Explicit Semantic Rules And Never Display-Name Or Prose Inference
Maneuver Targeting Conversion Is A Maneuver Effect And The Targeting Definition It References Does Not Duplicate The Effect's AP/MP Cost Or Save Profile
Canonical Maneuver Radius Equals Martial Rank Base Times STR, With Rank Bases Five, Ten And Fifteen Feet For Trained, Expert And Master
The Superseded Fixed Strength-Band Maneuver Radius Table Is Never Executed
Spell And Maneuver Targeting Geometry Formulas Compile Through M4 Formula Operations Rather Than Hidden Prowess Compiler Or UI Arithmetic
Targeting Definitions Preserve Exact EntityVersion, Ruleset, Composition And Formula Provenance
WO6 Targeting Evaluation Does Not Calculate Final Spell Or Maneuver Cost And Does Not Perform Runtime Resource Payment
Targeting Evaluation Is Deterministic, Immutable, JSON-Safe And Free Of Global Mutable Targeting State
Projectile Targeting Has A Listed Base Cost Of Three MP And Uses The Caster Current Applicable Range
Projectile Requires A Ranged Attack Roll For Delivery; This Delivery Check Is Distinct From The Effect Mechanical Outcome And Any Effect-Owned Saving Throw
When A Projectile-Delivered Effect Uses Attack-Roll Resolution, The Projectile Delivery Attack Is The Effect Attack And Is Never Rolled Twice
When A Projectile-Delivered Effect Uses Saving-Throw Resolution, Successful Projectile Delivery Occurs Before The Effect-Owned Saving Throw
Canonical Spell Line Length Equals Ten Feet Times PRO
Canonical Spell Line Width Equals Five Feet Times The Ceiling Of PRO Divided By Two
Effects Define What An Ability Does While Targeting Defines Delivery And Geometry; Targeting Never Owns Effect Outcomes
Saving Throw Identity And Save Profiles Are Effect-Owned Mechanics And Are Never Inferred From Targeting Geometry
SPELL_EFFECT And MANEUVER_EFFECT Are Separate Exact Definition Families That Share A Structural Effect Contract But Are Never Interchangeable
The Seven Canonical Top-Level Spell Effect Families Are Damage, Healing, Buff, Debuff, Control, Utility And Summoning
Cleanse Is A Healing Subfamily And Movement Is A Utility Subfamily; Neither Is A Separate Top-Level Spell Effect Family
Spell Interference Is A Utility Mechanic Rather Than A Top-Level Spell Effect Family
An Executable Canonical Spell Effect Must Explicitly Define Its Resolution Mode And Mechanical Outcome Metadata
A Maneuver Effect May Inherit The Maneuver Existing Resolution Only Through An Explicit Inherit-Ability Resolution Policy
Effect Saving-Throw Resolution Carries An Exact Authored Save Profile Or Exact Save-Selection Rule
Effect Targeting Compatibility Uses Exact Structured Identity Or Explicit Semantic Compatibility And Never Fuzzy Text Matching
Damage And Healing Character Dice Limits Apply Per Effect And Normally Cannot Exceed The Caster PRO
Effects Never Gain Secondary Mechanical Outcomes Merely From Flavor, Damage Type, Keywords Or Display Text
Effect Scaling Is Available Only Through Explicit Structured Scaling Rules And Parameters
Effect Listed AP And MP Contributions Are Construction Costs And Never Runtime Resource Payment
Mana Efficiency Never Changes An Effect Listed MP Cost
Effect Access And Prerequisites Reuse The Existing Structured Ability Construction Requirement System
Effect Stackability And Stack Limits Reuse WO5 Explicit Definition-Owned Stack Contract
Effect Duration Metadata Describes Compatibility And Defaults; The Ability Actual Duration Remains A Separate Component
Maneuver Targeting Conversion Is Owned By MANEUVER_EFFECT Definitions That Carry The Conversion Cost, Save Profile And Destination Targeting Reference
Maneuver Targeting Definitions Never Duplicate Conversion Effect Costs Or Save Profiles
Elemental Damage Conversion Changes Damage Type Only And Never Applies Unauthored Secondary Conditions
Maneuver Damage Normally Comes From Its Foundation Or Weapon Unless An Exact Maneuver Effect Explicitly Replaces That Source
Spell And Maneuver Effect Cost Contributions Are Not Combined Into Final Ability Cost During WO7
WO7 Does Not Execute Effect Chains, Runtime Damage, Healing, Conditions, Movement Or Resource Mutation
Effect Definitions Preserve Exact EntityVersion, Ruleset, Compatibility, Access, Keyword And Cost Provenance
Historical Effect Evaluation Never Resolves Through Latest Or Current Content
Effect Validation And Compilation Use Existing M4 Formula, Requirement And Keyword Primitives Rather Than Reimplementing Generic Rule Evaluation
Effect Evaluation Is Deterministic, Immutable, JSON-Safe And Free Of Global Mutable Effect State
Traits Are Exact Versioned Definitions With Explicit Shared Spell Or Maneuver Applicability
Trait Scope Selects The Ability An Effect Targeting Or A Resolution Explicitly
Trait Parameters Reuse Typed M5 Schemas And Reject Unknown Unsafe Or Invalid Selections
Trait Access Reuses Construction Requirements And Affinity Strength Keywords
Trait Modifications Cannot Smuggle Independent Effect Outcomes
Normal Spell Trait Capacity Preserves Approved Exchanges And Additional Affinity Capacity Is Separate
Authored Spells Preserve One Targeting Ordered Effects Explicit Authority And Structural Duration
Authored Maneuvers Inherit Attack Profiles And Check Every Committed Action
Maneuver Effects Retain Martial Capacity And Explicit Skill Requirements
Powerful Blow Is An Authored Action Group With Attached Effects Resolving Once
Authored Ability Plans And Inspector Sources Preserve Exact Ruleset And Historical Definition Pins
WO8 Is Deterministic Immutable JSON Safe And Does Not Execute Combat State
